v1_5_0_beta.title: What's new
features: Course projects: students join with a code and share the course's objects, and instructors and staff have their own codes. Please contact us if you are an instructor and would like to try this feature.
A record of who made and wrote what in each project, which everyone in the project can see and download
Every member of a site can publish, upload objects and upgrade
The story editor shows each step as the published story will lay it out
Glossary entries have kinds, and a layer panel can show an entry as a callout beside the text
Change a story's or an object's ID, edit custom object fields, and upload audio, PDF and WEBP objects
Answers are measured in lines as you write, and layer panels have a Footnote button
fixes: Edits made on GitHub are read before a publish instead of being overwritten
Published files keep their own columns, layout and front matter
Collaborators stay connected, and a save that fails comes back the next time you open the field
Upgrades list every change they make and leave your own settings alone
